## Validation

- [ ] I ran the relevant tests locally.
- [ ] I verified the Gradle build and Jar output when applicable.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for the changed behavior.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is limited to the stated purpose.
- [ ] Public API or behavior changes are documented.
- [ ] Security and backward compatibility were considered.
- [ ] The commit messages follow `<emoji><type>: <message>`.
- [ ] Each commit changes fewer than 300 lines.
